shots.caption: Cayde-6 under a hood, blue Exo faceplate and burning eyes emerging from shadow. The return shot.
Extreme close-up on a white Exo faceplate, dark eyes catching red light. Still and resolute.
Ikora Rey braces a hand against a comrade, lit teal and gold, urgent mid-conversation.
Mara Sov in fur mantle and gold sigil, hand raised mid-sentence, teal rim light. Commanding, wary.
Mara Sov levels a hand cannon into the dark, pale hair and scaled mantle catching low light.
Extreme close-up on Osiris's masked face beneath an ornate gold headdress, one eye catching cold light, as Sagira's spiked golden Ghost shell hovers beside him with its eye glowing.

A lone robed figure climbs a frost-dusted stairwell deep in Vex ruins, seen from behind and dwarfed by the architecture, silhouetted against a glowing triangular portal of light at the top of the stairs.
Osiris stands his ground as a towering Vex war-frame's armored claw reaches toward him from the shadows, a web of red laser trip-beams crackling between them in the ruined corridor.
Osiris reaches into a floating cluster of glowing cyan Vex glyphs, his gold headdress and cloth mask lit by their light as he studies the ancient script with both hands.
Osiris faces down a towering Vex war-frame as its weapon arm charges a beam, Sagira's small gold Ghost shell hovering loyally at his side in the hazy blue gloom.
A tight, face-clear close-up on Osiris beneath his ornate gold headdress and cloth mask, his eyes hard with focus as red hard-light beams streak past in the dark behind him.
Osiris and Sagira approach a massive glowing triangular Vex gateway together, seen small and distant beyond an out-of-focus alien weapon looming in the foreground.
Osiris and Sagira move deeper into a dim, green-lit Vex ruin as a Goblin perches on wreckage nearby and a distant Guardian trades fire in the haze beyond.
Osiris aims his rifle in profile beneath a wind-blown feather headdress as Sagira's spiked gold shell hovers beside him, two Vex machines watching from the ruined rock walls behind.
Extreme overhead angle on Osiris swinging a blazing solar sword down onto a Vex machine, sparks and firelight erupting around the blow as another Vex stands on the rocks nearby.
Osiris dives through the air wreathed in solar flame and burning wings, closing on a Vex Minotaur whose reflective visor fills the foreground.
Insert of Osiris's ornate gold gauntlet gripping a glowing blade hilt, cyan energy lines lit along the vambrace against the dark Vex ruin and firelight behind.
Seen from behind, Osiris vaults over broken stonework toward a spread of Vex machines across a ravine, weapon raised as red beams and a fiery blast light the canyon.
Close profile on Osiris beneath his wind-blown feather headdress, one eye glinting as he levels his rifle, Sagira's spiked gold shell glowing teal at his side.
Face-clear close-up on Osiris's weathered eyes above his gold chevron mask, framed by his ornate beaked headdress, Sagira's spiked shell resting quietly beside his head.
Wide shot of Osiris kneeling amid Vex wreckage, one hand raised and glowing as Sagira hovers beside him, a defeated Vex machine slumped nearby and a laser beam still cutting through the dark.
Tight face-clear close-up on Osiris's masked eyes beneath his beaked golden headdress, Sagira's spiked shell glowing bright teal right beside his head.
Osiris turns in profile beneath his gold beaked headdress and patterned face wrap as Sagira, his spiked golden Ghost, hovers at his shoulder among Mercury's ruins.
Close-up on Osiris's masked profile, eyes steady beneath his beaked gold headdress, as Sagira's spiked shell drifts at his shoulder.
Tight close-up on Osiris's eyes above his patterned face wrap, Sagira's golden spiked shell filling the frame just beside him.
Extreme close-up on Osiris's eyes and brow, feathers of his headdress filling the frame as he turns his masked face toward something offscreen.
Osiris, in profile, holds a small glowing Vex artifact out in his palm as machine sentries advance through the ruins behind him.
Extreme close-up on Osiris's masked face beneath an ornate gold headdress, one eye catching cold light, as Sagira's spiked golden Ghost shell hovers beside him with its eye glowing.

Close-up on a Vex war-frame's multi-barreled cannon arm firing a hard-light beam, purple radiolaria motes drifting past as Sagira's small gold Ghost shell darts through the line of fire in the background.
Extreme close-up on a Vex war-frame's massive weapon arm swinging into frame, while Sagira's small gold Ghost shell drifts through drifting debris and a crossing beam of light below.
Osiris faces down a towering Vex war-frame as its weapon arm charges a beam, Sagira's small gold Ghost shell hovering loyally at his side in the hazy blue gloom.
Osiris and Sagira approach a massive glowing triangular Vex gateway together, seen small and distant beyond an out-of-focus alien weapon looming in the foreground.
Sagira's spiked gold Ghost shell hangs alone in near-total darkness, her bright teal eye the only light in the frame.
Osiris and Sagira move deeper into a dim, green-lit Vex ruin as a Goblin perches on wreckage nearby and a distant Guardian trades fire in the haze beyond.
Osiris aims his rifle in profile beneath a wind-blown feather headdress as Sagira's spiked gold shell hovers beside him, two Vex machines watching from the ruined rock walls behind.

Wide shot of Osiris kneeling amid Vex wreckage, one hand raised and glowing as Sagira hovers beside him, a defeated Vex machine slumped nearby and a laser beam still cutting through the dark.
Tight face-clear close-up on Osiris's masked eyes beneath his beaked golden headdress, Sagira's spiked shell glowing bright teal right beside his head.
Osiris turns in profile beneath his gold beaked headdress and patterned face wrap as Sagira, his spiked golden Ghost, hovers at his shoulder among Mercury's ruins.
Close-up on Osiris's masked profile, eyes steady beneath his beaked gold headdress, as Sagira's spiked shell drifts at his shoulder.
Tight close-up on Osiris's eyes above his patterned face wrap, Sagira's golden spiked shell filling the frame just beside him.
A single silhouetted Guardian dwarfed by the vast pale sphere of the Traveler in cloud.
A winged silhouette stands centered in a vast ring of white light. Held at distance; face never given.
Zavala kneels on a windswept ridge, shield on his back, staring off. Weary command.
Zavala lit cold blue in a cockpit, jaw set, looking out past camera.
Profile of a helmeted Titan against pale sky, visor catching the light.
Zavala framed against a burning orange horizon, shield over his shoulder, eyes forward.
Zavala stands full-height against grey cloud, shield rigged on his back.
Tight profile of Zavala in blue light, the ghost of a smile breaking through.
